The SOC supplier requires the complete equality map of its input program. The original call named only h_E of the original program, without an auxiliary program; dependent Jacobian rows do not imply redundant nonlinear equalities. For example, at x=1, h=(z,z+(z-1)^2), f=0 and B=1 give h(x)=(1,1), Dh(x)=(1,1)^T, E={1}, p=-1 and h(x+p)=(0,1). Thus the retained row is corrected while the omitted nonlinear equality need not be. Repaired the call by explicitly supplying the auxiliary C2 program with equality map h_E and unchanged f,g,U,B. Consistent row reduction preserves its QP feasible set, so p remains an admissible SQP step and (h_E,g_J) meets the supplied rank and linearized-residual interface. Full original merit is retained.
